text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I spotted 
an Umamusume letting out a sleepy yawn.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, I keep lying in bed thinking 
about the next race, so I've been running 
on lack of sleep..."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I understand. As the race gets closer, you 
start feeling anxious, don't you? Are you 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"I might not be okay... I'll have to do my 
best not to fall asleep in class..."

Hold on, you sleep-deprived girl over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That choice is a non-non! You can't win 
the world if you don't take care of 
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Drifting along with conventional wisdom 
and giving up on what you want to do... 
You have to fight back against such 
absurdity!

text_block_list.name: Pearl & Windy
text_block_list.text:
We are the whirlwind that bites at the 
world! Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"You're the only one who can hear your 
body screaming!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If your body is begging for rest, then 
follow your instincts!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! If you are sleepy, you should 
simply take a nap, even during class!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh... But...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Overseas, they have this daytime nap 
period called a siesta!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Sleeping when you're sleepy is only 
natural!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Even so, sleeping in class is going a bit 
too far...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Um... Trainer-san, what do you think...?
choice_data_list: Let's take a nap during the break.
You ought to sleep properly at night.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Still, I feel a bit reluctant to sleep 
during the day...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem! When it's daytime in Japan, 
it's night in America!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: I-I see...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oka~y! Well then, I'm about to give you a 
real taste of an American night~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sleep peacefully to the sounds of a 
Broadway musical!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I'll be able to sleep...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you can't sleep, Windy-chan will 
hypnotize you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that nap, my head feels so 
clear, and I can really focus on class 
now!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Worldwide Windy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ufu♪ Looks like I've saved yet another 
lost sheep in a little corner of the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: You better thank Windy-chan and the gang~!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Letting yourself be swept away by common 
sense... What a troubled little lamb.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"It would be best if there was a way to 
sleep soundly at night, though..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If you rampage during the day, you'll be 
totally pooped and sleep like a log at 
night!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go around pulling pranks with 
Windy-chan right away!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh... A prank...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Here I go! To break out of the shell of 
conventional wisdom!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ever since then, I've been sleeping 
soundly through the night, and my daily 
rhythm has totally gotten back on track!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Also, running away from the Disciplinary 
Committee improved my race times!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
It's all going according to Windy-chan's 
calculations!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Still, it looks like those two are being 
called into the student guidance office, 
though..."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
No problem. Let's just tell the teacher 
that it was "to save a little lost lamb."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm barging right into the 
disciplinary office!
